about: Where the game's stat icons sit on texticons.png, the sheet item tooltips draw them from. The game publishes no map of the sheet, so these were found by hand. `pixels` is a hash of the 20x20 tile's RGBA pixels: `npm run data:art` stops when one no longer matches, and `npm run data:art -- --accept` records the tiles as they are now once they have been looked at.
